title: Direct Conversion of Adult Human Fibroblasts into Induced Neural Precursor Cells by Non-Viral Transfection.
protocol: Purify plasmid DNA using the PureLink HiPure Filter Maxiprep kit.
Purchase pCMV-SPORT6 containing PAX6 cDNA from Life Technologies.
Purchase SOX2 cDNA from Addgene.
Clone SOX2 cDNA into pEGFP-N1 after removing eGFP expression cassette.
Use pEGFP-N1 construct as a transfection control to confirm transfection success.
Construct bicistronic plasmids using pLVX-IRES-zsGreen for SOX2 and pLVX-IRES-tdTomato for PAX6.
Utilize pairs of cistronic or bicistronic plasmids based on the experimental endpoint.
Purchase primary adult human fibroblast cells from either Cell Applications Ltd or the Coriell Biorepository.
Proliferate and passage cells in flasks until reaching the required cell number.
Plate cells onto uncoated Nunclon plates at a density of 52,000 cells per cm².
Co-transfect cells with SOX2 and PAX6 plasmid DNA using Lipofectamine LTX reagent or K2 reagent for transfection.
Change the media to “neural reprogramming media” on the third day post-transfection.
Supplement the media with 25 ng/mL Midkine for the first 18 days.
Change the media three times per week.
Replate cells weekly after 30 days and collect when iNP colony formation is optimal.

Characterize iNP cells by analyzing expression of neural stem and precursor genes including OCT3/4, SOX1, SOX2, NANOG, PAX6, BMI1, HES1, FOXG1, SIX3, GLI3, NGN2, EMX2, TBR2, DLX2, ASCL1, NCAM1, OLIG2.
Isolate total RNA from colonies of independent iNP cell lines and fibroblast control lines using the Nucleospin RNA kit.
Synthesize cDNA from isolated total RNA using Superscript III reverse transcriptase.
Perform three independent duplex qPCR reactions for each sample using the TaqMan® system with ribosomal 18S rRNA as the internal standard.
Use an equivalent of 4-10 ng mRNA per reaction in qPCR.
Calculate the fold change in gene expression using the ΔΔCT method.
Present the fold change relative to the mean expression level in fibroblast control lines.
Prepare Human Dermal Fibroblast Proliferation Medium using DMEM and 2% FBS, or use Human Fibroblast Growth medium from Cell Applications Ltd.
Set up Neural Reprogramming Medium by combining Neurobasal-A medium with 0.3% D-glucose, 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin/Glutamine, 2% B27 supplement, 20 ng/mL EGF, 2 μg/mL Heparin, and 1 mM VPA.
Prepare Neuronal Plating Medium using Neurobasal-A medium with 0.3% D-glucose, 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin/Glutamine, 2% B27 supplement, 25 ng/mL FGF2, 0.01 mM Retinoic acid, and 1% FBS.
Set up Neuronal Striatal Differentiation Medium – Stage 1 by combining Neural Plating Medium ingredients with 1% N2 supplement, 250 ng/mL Shh, 100 ng/mL Dkk1, 20 ng/mL BDNF, and 10 μM Y27632.
Loosen lid of ampoule and thaw quickly by placing the lower half of tube in a 37 °C water bath until a small piece of ice remains (approximately 1 min).
Dilute cells in 5 mL of Fibroblast proliferation media, centrifuge at 350 g for 5 min to remove DMSO from the sample.
Decant off supernatant then flick tube hard to break up cell pellet.
Add half the appropriate volume of media for the flask size and add cells to flask, wash the tube with remaining media to meet the total volume for the flask (5 mL for T25, 10 mL for T75 flask).
Distribute cells evenly and incubate at 5% CO2, 37 °C.
Do not disrupt culture for the first 24-48 hours.
Change proliferation medium every second day.
Subculture human dermal fibroblasts when they are 70-85% confluent.
Remove medium from the flask without disturbing the cell layer.
Add warm PBS to rinse the cells.
Aspirate PBS and add warm Trypsin/0.05% EDTA to cover the cells, rock flask until surface is covered.
Incubate at room temperature, tapping after 1-2 min to check for detachment.
If cells are resistant to detachment, incubate at 37 °C for 1-2 minutes.
Do not leave trypsin on longer than necessary.
As soon as all cells are loose, add fibroblast proliferation media.
Collect cells into a 50 mL tube and rinse flask with more media until all cells are collected.
Centrifuge (350 g; 5 min), decant off supernatant and discard.
Tap to loosen pellet then resuspend, and plate out as appropriate for a 1:2 split.
Repeat the process until the desired number of cells has been reached.
Switch cells to Opti-MEM medium at 37 °C for 1 hr before transfection.
If using K2 reagent, add 40 µL K2 multiplier to the cells during incubation.
Mix DNA plasmids and Plus Reagent with Opti-MEM to a total volume of 200 µL per well.
Prepare a second mix by adding LTX or K2 transfection reagent to Opti-MEM for each well.
Gently add the DNA mix to the transfection reagent mix, mix by inverting, swirling and tapping.
Do not vortex or pipette repeatedly.
Incubate for 5 min (Lipofectamine LTX) or 20 min (K2 reagent) at room temperature to allow complex formation.
Add 400 µL of mix to each well of cells.
Incubate 5 hr (Lipofectamine LTX) or overnight (K2 reagent) at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
Remove medium and replace with fibroblast proliferation medium after the incubation.
Check the cells under a microscope on days 2-4.
Replace the proliferation medium with neural reprogramming media supplemented with 25 ng/mL Midkine.
Change the cell media three times per week.
Remove the Midkine component of the neural reprogramming medium on Day 22.
Note that cell survival is compromised if Midkine remains in culture past this stage.
On Day 31, remove the medium and retain it for floating iNP cells.
Wash the cells with warm PBS and retain the wash solution for any floating cells.
Add trypsin/0.05% EDTA to cover the cells and tap to detach them.
Add warm neural reprogramming medium to collect detached cells and transfer into a centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 350 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in fresh neural reprogramming medium.
Count the cells and replate at approximately 31,250 cells/cm² (300,000 per 6-well plate format well).
Continue with thrice-weekly media changes and once-weekly passages until full iNP colony formation is achieved.
During media changes, take just the top media leaving low-lying floating cells if present.
Centrifuge waste media to collect floating cells when passaging a mixed culture of adherent and floating cells.
Place collected floating cells back into the dish with adherent cells and fresh media.
Ensure that floating cells and colonies are retained at each media change.
Replate retained cells along with adherent cells.
Collect iNP cells when mostly pure colonies (few or no fibroblasts) are achieved (usually around day 40-55).
Remove the medium, keeping it to conserve any floating iNP cells.
Wash cells with warm PBS, retaining this in case of floating cells.
Add trypsin/0.05% EDTA to cover the cells and tap to detach.
Add warm neural reprogramming medium to collect detached cells.
Centrifuge collected cells at 350 g for 5 min to pellet them.
Freeze cell pellet at -80 °C or proceed to isolate RNA.
Isolate RNA from the cell pellet using an isolation kit such as the Macherey Nagel Nucleospin RNA kit, following manufacturer’s directions.
Elute RNA in a very small volume (e.g., 30 µL).
Measure RNA concentration and quality utilizing a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.
Synthesize cDNA from high-quality RNA using a kit such as the SuperScript III First Strand Synthesis kit.
Use either oligoDT and/or random hexamer primers following the manufacturer’s protocol.
Include a RT negative sample to confirm specificity of RT reaction.
Ensure genomic DNA has been removed enzymatically.
Dilute synthesized cDNA, for example to 4 ng/µL, in RNAse-free water.
Synthesize cDNA of all iNP and control samples for analysis at the same time with the same amount of RNA.
Dispense qPCR reagents along with the cDNA template in triplicate.
Add VIC-labelled assay for normalization gene \(20x) 0.5 µL per reaction.
Add FAM-labelled assay for gene of interest \(20x) 0.5 µL per reaction.
Add TaqMan Gene Expression Master mix \(2x; Cat #4369514) 5 µL per reaction.
Seal the plate with film and keep in the dark until loading into the qPCR machine.
Tap gently to mix components in the plate.
Centrifuge \(2000 g for 1 min) prior to thermal cycling.
Perform PCR with the following parameters: Cycle number Denature Anneal/extend
Cycle number 1 95 °C, 10 min
Cycle numbers 2 - 41 95 °C, 15 sec 60 °C, 1 min
Analyze the cycle threshold (Ct) values for FAM-labelled samples.
Normalize Ct values to a VIC-labelled housekeeping gene.
Calculate fold changes in gene expression relative to HDF samples using the △△Ct method.
Coat the plating surface with 0.01% poly-ornithine at room temperature for 1 hour.
Allow the coated surface to dry, overnight if necessary.
Add 10 µg/mL laminin and incubate at 37 °C for at least 1 hour.
Remove the coating solution and add media containing cells immediately.
Do not allow the laminin to dry on the plate.
Break up iNP cells using a pipettor.
Plate cells at high density in Neuronal plating media onto coated slides or plates.
Approximate the number of wells based on the last replate count.
Check the density of one well before continuing to ensure accuracy.
Keep cells in Neuronal plating media for 1 day to assist attachment.
On Day 3, switch cells into specific differentiation media as required.
For Neuronal Striatal Stage 1 medium, gently change media every 2 days for 10 days.
Switch cells to Neuronal Striatal Stage 2 medium after 10 days.
Gently change media every 2 days for approximately 20 days in Neuronal Striatal Stage 2 medium.
Fix cells for immunocytochemical analyses.
For Neuronal mixed medium, gently change media every 2 days for 14 days.
Fix cells for immunocytochemical analyses.
Handle culture plates carefully and ensure gentle media changes to prevent cell loss.
Prepare multiple replicates for FACs analysis with a minimum count of 10,000 cells.
Transfect cells with a fluorescently-tagged plasmid or stain with primary antibody followed by fluorescent secondary antibody if using non-fluorescent plasmids.
Collect cells one to three days post-transfection via trypsinization and resuspend in FACs buffer (e.g., 500 µL of PBS + 1% FBS).
Pass the cell suspension through a cell strainer into a polystyrene FACs tube.
Perform FACs analysis to quantify fluorescently expressing cells as a percentage of total living cells.
Coat plastic plates with laminin (10 µg/mL) for 1 hr at 37 °C.
Collect iNP cells using trypsin/EDTA or mechanical dissociation.
Resuspend in fresh neural reprogramming medium, count the cells and replate at ~31,250 cells/cm² or less.
Incubate for 24-48 hr.
Aspirate the medium and wash with room temperature PBS.
Fix the cells with cold 4% (vol/vol) paraformaldehyde in PB for 10 min.
Wash each well with PBS.
Permeabilize the cells with PBS + 0.2% Triton-X for 2x 5 min.
Add primary antibodies in PBS with 3% serum and incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Wash the wells with PBS twice for 5 min each.
Add the fluorescent secondary antibodies at 1:500 in PBS + 3% serum. Incubate for 1 hr at room temperature.
Wash the wells 2x 5 min with PBS.
Add DAPI at 1:1000 in 0.1 M PB for 10 min.
Rinse with 0.1 M PB and add fresh 0.1 M PB for imaging.
Image under a fluorescent microscope.
Fix the differentiated cells as in Step 4-6 of Box 3.
Permeabilize the cells 3 times for 2 minutes each with PBS + 0.2% Triton-X.
Image under a fluorescent microscope.
